products.name: Belt Eligibility Board
products.product: A focused martial arts belt testing eligibility workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent martial arts academies and multi-program dojos
products.problem: Attendance, curriculum signoffs, instructor judgment, fees, equipment, and testing invitations are reconciled shortly before promotion events.
products.valueProposition: Turns martial arts belt testing eligibility into a visible operating queue so every testing invitation reflects the school's recorded progression criteria and an explicit instructor decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets martial arts belt testing eligibility software, martial arts belt testing eligibility tracker, martial arts belt testing eligibility template, and martial arts belt testing eligibility checklist searches.

products.name: Trial Student Follow-Up
products.product: A focused martial arts trial student follow-up workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent martial arts academies and multi-program dojos
products.problem: Trial bookings, attendance, student goals, parent questions, fit decisions, and promised callbacks scatter across calendars and inboxes.
products.valueProposition: Turns martial arts trial student follow-up into a visible operating queue so every trial receives the promised, context-aware next step or a documented closed reason.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
